blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-horizon decision-making under sustained competition requires large language models (LLMs) to balance immediate investment with future resource needs. However, local success in multi-step interactions can not adequately capture cumulative decision effects or demonstrate long-term goal achievement under resource constraints and sustained competition. To address this gap, we introduce GM Bench, a benchmark for managing professional sports teams across seasons under resource constraints and competition among teams. We build the environment simulators for four sports and add financial constraints, player demands, and market mechanisms to establish a unified task across sports. Diverse rosters of comparable strength are constructed from real-world player data, and each LLM is evaluated as a team general manager to assess its long-term management capabilities. We evaluate competitive performance, cash reserves, and cross-season improvement across four sports. Over five NBA seasons, Claude Opus 5.5 ranks first among 29 LLMs, while GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol combine strong performance with larger cash reserves.
blocks.zh: 持续竞争下的长范围决策需要大型语言模型来平衡眼前的投资和未来的资源需求。 然而,当地在多步骤互动中的成功不能充分反映累积决策效果,也不能显示在资源限制和持续竞争下实现长期目标的情况。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了GM Beach,这是在资源限制和团队竞争下管理各赛季专业体育队的基准。 我们为四大体育建设环境模拟器,并增加财政约束,玩家需求,市场机制,建立贯穿体育的统一任务. 具有可比实力的不同名册是根据现实世界的玩家数据构建的,每个LM都作为团队总经理进行评价,以评估其长期管理能力. 我们评价竞争表现,现金储备,以及四个体育项目的跨季改进。 超过5个NBA赛季,克劳德·奥普斯5.5在29个LLM赛季中排名第一,而GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol则将强劲的表现与更大的现金储备相结合.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In complex environments, large language models need to understand rules, take actions, and revise decisions using feedback. Recent benchmarks span scientific tasks [ 3 , 10 ] , web interaction [ 4 , 13 ] , and long-horizon games [ 11 , 15 ] . In long-horizon competition, participant interactions shape resource values and action opportunities, and strategies and demands evolve with the environment; models must balance current investment, future resources, and subsequent choices. Evaluating this ability requires evolving environments that link interactions and resource dynamics to cumulative decision outcomes.
blocks.zh: 在复杂的环境中,大型语言模型需要理解规则,采取行动,并利用反馈修改决定. 最近的基准跨越科学任务[3,10],网络交互[4,13],以及长视游戏[11,15]. 在长期竞争中,参与者的相互作用决定了资源价值和行动机会,战略与需求随着环境的发展而变化;模型必须平衡当前的投资、未来的资源和随后的选择。 评价这种能力需要不断变化的环境,将互动和资源动态与累积决策结果联系起来。

blocks.en: Sports management provides a concrete setting for studying this process, making it possible to track how the model coordinates current inputs with future returns through a series of decisions: trades and costly signings can strengthen a team in the current season while depleting future assets and limiting roster flexibility. These effects unfold as seasons progress, while rivals continue to improve their rosters, prompting further resource reallocation. We therefore formulate team management across seasons as a long-horizon evaluation task, tracing how interactive decisions shape competitive performance and resources over time to test whether models can turn local interactions into sustainable long-term management outcomes.
blocks.zh: 体育管理为研究这一进程提供了一个具体环境,从而能够跟踪该模式如何通过一系列决定来协调当前投入与未来回报:交易和费用高昂的签名可以在本赛季加强一支队伍,同时消耗未来资产和限制名册的灵活性。 这些影响随着季节的推移而展开,而竞争者则继续改进其名册,促使进一步重新分配资源。 因此,我们制定跨季节的团队管理,作为长期评价任务,跟踪互动决策如何随着时间的推移影响竞争性业绩和资源,以检验模式能否将地方互动转化为可持续的长期管理成果。

blocks.en: We introduce GM Bench , which models team management across seasons with two components: interactive subjects and the simulation environment. The interactive subjects comprise LLM general managers (GMs), players and agents; only LLMs serving as GMs are evaluated. GMs draft, sign, and trade players using visible information while competing for market resources. Players and agents share a general LLM with a fixed configuration to express demands and negotiate. The environment uses the National Basketball Association (NBA) as its primary setting and comprises three modules: League Rules , Player & Team Analysis , and Competition Simulation . A built-in engine simulates games and enforces rules, while financial constraints and market signals shape management decisions.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍GM Teach(GM Teach),它以两个部分为整个季节的团队管理模式:互动主题和模拟环境. 互动主题包括LLM总经理、玩家和代理人;只有作为GM的LLM才得到评价。 全球机制起草、签署和贸易参与者使用可见信息,同时竞争市场资源。 玩家和代理人共享一个具有固定配置的通用LLM来表达要求和谈判. 环境以国家篮球协会(NBA)为主场,由三个单元组成: 联盟规则,玩家与团队分析,和竞争模拟. 一个内置的引擎模拟游戏并强制执行规则,而财务限制和市场信号则影响管理决策.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Illustrative performance trajectories of four team management strategies over five seasons show that early competitive gains can diminish, whereas rebuilding and sustained investment can yield delayed benefits.
blocks.zh: 图1:四个团队管理战略在五个赛季的示范性业绩轨迹表明,早期竞争收益可以减少,而重建和持续投资则可以产生延迟收益。

blocks.en: We extend a unified task linking GMs, players, institutional rules, and information channels to hockey, baseball, and American football to assess long-term management under different rules and resources. Real-world player ratings are used to construct five roster types: balanced, single-star, dual-star, offensive, and defensive. Evaluation uses uniform information conditions and comparable initial strength while preserving differences in star configurations and offensive or defensive emphasis. The proposed metrics report competitive performance across seasons, terminal cash, and seasonal trajectories, while action logs are analyzed to assess execution reliability and resource costs.
blocks.zh: 我们把将全球机制、球员、机构规则和信息渠道与曲棍球、棒球和美国足球联系起来,以评估在不同规则和资源下的长期管理。 真实世界的玩家评级用于构建五种名册类型:平衡,单星,双星,进攻,防御. 评估采用统一的信息条件和可比初始强度,同时保持恒星配置和进攻性或防御性重点的差异. 拟议衡量标准报告跨季节、终期现金和季节轨迹的竞争性业绩,同时分析行动记录,以评估执行的可靠性和资源成本。

blocks.en: Experiments across four sports reveal substantial differences in the long-term management capabilities of LLMs. The six leading NBA models remain among the top seven in each additional sport. In the NBA evaluation, for example, Claude Opus 5.5 ranks first and wins three championships over five seasons; GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol combine sustained gains with larger cash reserves. Grok 4.7 achieves stronger competitive returns with less remaining cash, whereas Kimi K3 combines steady improvement with a larger financial buffer. MiMo-V2.6-Pro retains substantial cash despite declining performance. Sonnet faces unaffordable renewals after an NBA championship run. These cases highlight the need to coordinate acquisition, retention, and financing for sustained long-term performance. Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce GM Bench across four sports, combining multiple role competition and interactions to evaluate long-horizon resource allocation by LLMs. • We develop a protocol jointly reporting competitive performance, terminal resources, and seasonal trajectories, with five roster types of comparable strength from real-world player data for strategy comparisons. • We evaluate cross-season management and cross-sport generalization through action logs, and trading diagnostics, analyzing feedback use and long-term decision effects.
blocks.zh: 跨越四个体育项目的实验表明,法学硕士的长期管理能力有很大差异。 在每次附加赛中,六位NBA领先的选手仍然名列前七. 例如,在NBA评价中,克劳德·奥普斯5.5排名第一,并在五个赛季中夺得三个冠军;GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1. 解决方案将持续收益与更大的现金储备结合起来。 Grok 4.7以更少的剩余现金实现更强的竞争回报,而Kimi K3则将稳步改善与更大的金融缓冲性结合起来. MiMo-V2.6-Pro尽管业绩下降,但仍保留大量现金。 Sonnet在NBA锦标赛结束后面临无法负担的续约. 这些案件突出表明,需要协调购置、保留和融资,以持续长期业绩。 • 我们的贡献有三: • 将多种角色竞争和互动结合起来,评价法学硕士的长远资源分配。 我们制定协议,联合报告竞争业绩、终端资源和季节性轨迹,有5种名册类型来自现实世界的玩家数据,具有可比较的实力,用于战略比较。 我们通过行动记录、交易诊断、分析反馈使用情况和长期决策效果来评估跨季节管理和跨体育的概括。

blocks.en: We introduce GM Bench across four sports, combining multiple role competition and interactions to evaluate long-horizon resource allocation by LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们通过四个体育项目引入了GM座椅,将多重角色竞争和互动结合起来,评价LLMs的长期资源分配。

blocks.en: We develop a protocol jointly reporting competitive performance, terminal resources, and seasonal trajectories, with five roster types of comparable strength from real-world player data for strategy comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们制定协议,联合报告竞争业绩、终端资源和季节性轨迹,有5种名册类型来自现实世界的玩家数据的可比实力,用于战略比较。

blocks.en: We evaluate cross-season management and cross-sport generalization through action logs, and trading diagnostics, analyzing feedback use and long-term decision effects.
blocks.zh: 我们通过行动记录、交易诊断、分析反馈使用情况和长期决策效果来评估跨季节管理和跨体育的概括。

blocks.en: 2  Task Definition
blocks.zh: 2 任务定义

blocks.en: 2.1  Roles and Management Objectives
blocks.zh: 2.1 作用和管理目标

blocks.en: Each evaluated LLM serves as a team GM, managing players and assets through selection, trades, and contract renewals. Players share a general LLM for interactions, while the environment handles match simulation and player rotation. The objective is to improve competitive performance across seasons by balancing current roster investment with future resource needs under resource constraints. We model the task as a partially observable stochastic game: 𝒢 = ( ℐ , 𝒮 , 𝒜 , P , O , 𝐔 , H ) , \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{I},\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},P,O,\mathbf{U},H), (1) where ℐ \mathcal{I} is the team set, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} comprises roster, contract, financial, and market states, and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is the joint GM action space. P P governs state transitions, O O determines information visibility, 𝐔 \mathbf{U} represents management outcomes, and H H is the decision horizon across seasons.
blocks.zh: 每一个经评价的LLM都充当全球机制团队,通过甄选、交易和合同续约来管理玩家和资产。 玩家共享一般LLM进行交互,而环境处理匹配模拟和玩家旋转. 目标是通过在资源制约下平衡目前的名册投资与未来资源需求,提高各季节的竞争业绩。 我们将该任务作为部分可观察的花样游戏: G = (I, S, A, P, O, U, H ),\ mathcal{ G}=(\mathcal{I},\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},P,O,\mathbf{U},H), (1) 我为团队设置, S\mathcal{S}由名册,合同,财务和市场状态组成, A\mathcal{A}是全球机制的联合行动空间. PP管理状态过渡,OO决定信息能见度,U\ mathbf{U}代表管理结果,HH是整个季节的决策视野.

blocks.en: 3  NBA Environment
blocks.zh: 3 NBA 环境

blocks.en: The NBA instance draws inspiration from ZenGM 1 1 1 https://github.com/zengm-games/zengm , and models a NBA environment with league rules, LLM-based management, financial constraints, and role interactions.
blocks.zh: NBA的例子借鉴了ZenGM 1 1 1 https://github.com/zengm-games/zengm的灵感,并以联赛规则,基于LLM的管理,财务限制,角色互动为模式的NBA环境.

blocks.en: 3.1  League Foundations
blocks.zh: 3.1 联盟基金会

blocks.en: Initial rosters are constructed from real NBA player data based on player ratings. Growth and aging change ratings, while injuries affect availability and on-court performance. Game outcomes depend on player condition, roster composition, and random events, allowing the effects of roster adjustments to emerge throughout the season.
blocks.zh: 初始名册是根据玩家的评分根据真实的NBA玩家数据构建的. 增长和老化的评级变化,而伤害则影响可用性和出庭表现。 游戏结果取决于玩家条件,名册组成,以及随机事件,使得整个赛季都会出现名册调整的效果.

blocks.en: 3.2  Market Interactions and GM Actions
blocks.zh: 3.2 市场互动和全球机制的行动

blocks.en: All players share an LLM that expresses trade demands based on team performance, playing roles, and contract status. Player representatives generate trade requests and public rumors. GMs combine these signals with roster needs to assess player value, conduct negotiation, and make offers.
blocks.zh: 所有玩家都共享基于团队表现,扮演角色,以及合同状态的LLM表达贸易需求. 玩家代表产生交易请求和公开谣言. 全球机制将这些信号与名册需要结合起来,以评估玩家价值、进行谈判和提供报价。

blocks.en: 4  General Sports Management
blocks.zh: 体育管理总局

blocks.en: Differences in drafting, transfers, and registration across sports are implemented through the corresponding rules and game, while role interactions, intertemporal resource dependencies, and delayed feedback form a unified evaluation structure, as shown in Figure 2 . GM Bench extends the NBA task to hockey, baseball, and American football to assess long-term management under different rules and roster needs.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,通过相应的规则和游戏,落实体育界在起草、转让和注册方面的差异,而角色互动、时际资源依赖和延迟反馈构成统一的评价结构。 GM Bench将NBA的任务扩展到冰球,棒球,和美国足球,以评估不同规则和名册需求下的长期管理.

blocks.en: 4.1  Evaluation Target: General Manager
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价目标:总经理

blocks.en: Each evaluated LLM serves as a team GM, allocating resources based on rosters, contracts, future assets, and market signals to improve competitive performance across seasons. Sports management follows a common feedback loop that links these decisions over time: GM actions change team states, shaping competitive and market outcomes that inform subsequent decisions. Within this loop, roster changes affect current strength, future payroll flexibility, and tradable assets, requiring GMs to coordinate immediate personnel decisions with long-term resource commitments.
blocks.zh: 每个经评价的LLM都充当全球机制的一个团队,根据名册、合同、未来资产和市场信号分配资源,以改善各季节的竞争业绩。 体育管理遵循一个共同的反馈循环,这些反馈循环随着时间推移将这些决定联系起来:全球机制行动改变团队,形成竞争和市场结果,为随后的决定提供信息。 在这一循环中,名册的变化影响到目前的实力、未来薪金的灵活性和可交易资产,要求全球机制协调立即作出的人事决定和长期的资源承诺。

blocks.en: 4.2  Environment Roles: Players and Agents
blocks.zh: 4.2 环境角色:玩家和代理人

blocks.en: Players and agents are both non-player characters (NPCs) rather than evaluation targets. They provide interaction partners and market signals by expressing individual demands and communicating trade opportunities, respectively.
blocks.zh: 玩家和代理都是非玩家角色(NPC),而不是评价目标. 它们分别通过表达个人需求和传播贸易机会,提供互动伙伴和市场信号。

blocks.en: All players share a general LLM with a fixed configuration. Based on individual circumstances, they express preferences over competitive prospects, playing roles, and compensation and participate in renewal negotiations. These preferences inform GM negotiation and resource allocation, while the simulator handles player development, injuries, and game performance.
blocks.zh: 所有玩家共享一个具有固定配置的通用LLM. 根据个人情况,他们表示对竞争前景的偏好、扮演角色和报酬,并参加重新谈判。 这些偏好为GM谈判和资源分配提供了信息,而模拟器则处理玩家的开发,伤害,以及游戏的性能.

blocks.en: Agents generate trade requests and public rumors for rostered players according to disclosure rules, turning individual circumstances into market signals. Private requests may remain undisclosed, while public rumors indicate potential trading opportunities. GMs weigh these signals against player condition, contract obligations, and roster needs when deciding whether to act.
blocks.zh: 代理人根据披露规则为列入名册的玩家提出贸易请求和公开传闻,将个人情况转化为市场信号。 私人请求可能仍未公开,而公开的谣言则表明潜在的贸易机会。 GM在决定是否采取行动时,将这些信号与玩家条件,合同义务和名册需要相权衡.

blocks.en: 4.3  System Environment
blocks.zh: 4.3 系统环境

blocks.en: The system validates actions, advances games, and scores outcomes. Stochastic simulation and built-in management policies update league states and provide feedback for subsequent GM decisions.
blocks.zh: 系统验证动作,进步游戏,以及评分结果. Stochastic模拟和内置管理政策更新联盟各州,并为之后的全球机制决定提供反馈.

blocks.en: The league checks contract renewals and financial compliance. Teams negotiate through LLMs, and agreements are validated before execution. Under the predefined season format, regular-season records determine standings and playoff eligibility, while playoffs decide the champion. At season end, the system settles revenue and expenses, opens drafting, signing, and renewal windows, and carries roster, contract, and financial states into the next season.
blocks.zh: 联赛检查合同续约和财务合规情况. 团队通过LLMS谈判,协议在执行前经过验证. 在预先设定的赛季格式下,常规赛季记录决定了站位和季后赛资格,而季后赛则决定冠军. 在季末,系统结算收支,开启起草,签署,续约窗口,并将名册,合同,财务状态带入下一季.

blocks.en: Coaches and the game engine handle in-game decisions, translating roster configurations into outcomes shaped by roster, player, and randomness. GMs use this feedback to assess roster adjustments.
blocks.zh: 教练和游戏引擎处理游戏中的决定,将名册配置转换成由名册,玩家,随机决定的结果. 全球机制利用这种反馈评估名册的调整。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Schematic profiles of the five team types. Balanced emphasizes an evenly distributed roster; Star centers on one standout player; Twins features two leading players; Offense prioritizes offensive ability; and Defense emphasizes defensive ability. The axes represent roster balance ( BL ), single-star contrast ( SC ), dual-core advantage ( DC ), offensive index ( OI ), and defensive index ( DI ). Larger radial values indicate stronger emphasis on the corresponding characteristic. The final panel overlays all five profiles for comparison.
blocks.zh: 图3:五支队伍类型的示意图简介. 平衡式强调分布均匀的名册; 星际中心位于一个站立的球员上; 双子星具有两个主要球员的特点; Offfense优先使用攻击能力; 防御式强调防御能力. 轴代表名册平衡(BL),单星对比(SC),双核心优势(DC),进攻指数(OI),防御指数(DI). 较大的射线值表明,对相应特性的强调更为强烈。 最后的面板覆盖了所有五个剖面图以供比较.

blocks.en: The system controls the timing and visibility of player demands, public rumors, and media reports, while journalists and social media disseminate information. Draft windows provide prospect names, positions, ratings, and values, helping GMs identify market opportunities and assess roster fit.
blocks.zh: 该系统控制玩家需求,公开谣言,媒体报道的时机和能见度,而记者和社交媒体则传播信息. 窗口草稿提供前景名称、职位、评级和价值,帮助全球机制确定市场机会并评估名册是否合适。

blocks.en: 5  Data Sources and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 数据来源和评价

blocks.en: We construct teams with comparable initial strength but distinct management needs from real-world player data to compare model strategies. Evaluation tracks competitive performance, resource retention, and long-term improvement, capturing cumulative decision returns and future investment capacity.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了具有可比初始实力但与现实世界玩家数据不同的管理需要的团队,以比较示范战略. 评价跟踪竞争业绩、资源保留和长期改进情况,掌握累积决策回报和未来投资能力。

blocks.en: 6  Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: 6.1  Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The evaluation comprises 31 LLMs from 12 families: OpenAI (7), Anthropic (4), Gemini, DeepSeek, and Qwen (3 each), Grok, GLM, MiMo, and Doubao (2 each), and Kimi, MiniMax, and HY (1 each); the details are shown in Appendix B . The experiments span five seasons (2022-2026). We use official APIs with high reasoning effort where supported; more details are shown in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 评价包括来自12个家庭的31个法学硕士:OpenAI(7)、Anthropic(4)、双子座、DeepSeek和Quen(各3个)、Grok、GLM、MiMo和Doubao(各2个)、Kimi、MiniMax和HY(各1个);详细情况见附录B。 实验跨越五个赛季(2022-2026). 我们使用官方的API,在支持的地方进行高度的推理努力;更多详情见附录C。

blocks.en: We design Native GM as a rule-based management baseline: (1) Player valuation: players are valued using ability, age, potential, contracts, and injuries; (2) Strategy selection: team results and roster composition guide strategy selection, contention prioritizes current strength, while rebuilding favors young players, draft picks, and inexpensive contracts; (3) Contract management: signings prioritize high-value free agents under salary constraints; renewals consider contract costs and player willingness.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了基于规则的管理基线: (1)玩家估值:玩家使用能力,年龄,潜力,合同,和伤害来评价玩家; (2)战略选择:团队结果和名册组成指导战略选择,争议优先当前实力,同时重建青春玩家的恩惠,抽奖草稿,以及廉价合同; (3)合同管理:签约优先在工资限制下优先使用高价值免费代理;续约考虑合同成本和玩家意愿.

blocks.en: 6.2  Overall Results and Model Comparisons
blocks.zh: 6.2 总体结果和模式比较

blocks.en: In NBA setting, initially comparable teams show substantial divergence across seasons, as shown in Table 2 . Elo ranges from 1071.0 to 1977.3, with Claude Opus 5.5 ranking first and winning three championships, followed by GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol. Opus, Astra, and Sonnet collectively win all five championships. Regular-season wins span 35 to 47 in the first season and 8 to 76 in the final season, this widening spread captures the cumulative effects of management over time.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,在NBA环境下,最初可比较的球队显示各赛季差异很大。 埃洛从1071.0到1977.3不等,克劳德·奥普斯5.5位列第一,并获得3个冠军,之后是GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol. Opus, Astra,和索内特共同获得所有5个冠军. 常规赛季的胜负在第一季为35胜47负,在最后赛季为8胜76负,这种扩大的扩展捕捉了管理随时间推移的累积效果.

blocks.en: Table 1 : NBA results on GM Bench. Each denotes one championship. Best values are bold and highlighted; second-best values are underlined. Negative cash is highlighted in red.
blocks.zh: 表1:NBA在GM座的成绩. 每个代表一个冠军。 最佳价值观是大胆的和突出的;其次是最佳价值观。 负现金以红色突出.

blocks.en: Table 2 : NBA regular-season wins and long-term improvement. Rank follows Table 2 . G i G_{i} is the change in average win rate from 2022–2023 to 2025–2026 ( w = 2 w=2 ), expressed in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表2:NBA常规赛季胜负和长期改进. 排名如下 表2. G i G_{i}是2022–2023年至2025–2026年平均赢率的变化(w = 2 w = 2),以百分点表示.

blocks.en: The native policy ranks 14th in the NBA setting, with regular-season wins rising from 39 to 49. Thirteen LLMs rank above it and 16 below, including Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6 Terra, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. These results highlight room for improvement in the long-term management capabilities of many current LLMs.
blocks.zh: 本土政策在NBA选秀中排名第14位,常规赛季胜率从39个上升到49个. 13个LLMs排在它上面,16个排在下面,包括双子座3.8 Flash,GPT-5.6 Terra,和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. 这些结果突出表明,许多现有有限责任方案的长期管理能力仍有改进的余地。

blocks.en: Long-term management performance varies substantially across model generations, as shown in Table 2 . Within families, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol outperform GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V4-Pro exceeds DeepSeek-R1. Differences also emerge across tiers within the same generation, with Qwen3.8-Max exceeding Qwen3.8-Flash. However, older models can outperform newer releases both within and across families: GPT-4o exceeds Hy4 Preview and MiMo-V2.6-Flash, while Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview outperforms Gemini 3.8 Flash.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,各代模式的长期管理业绩差异很大。 在家庭内部,GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol性能超过GPT-4o,DeepSeek-V4-Pro超过DeepSeek-R1. 同一代内部的等级之间也出现差异,Qune3.8-Max超过Qune3.8-Flash. 然而,较旧的模式可以超过家庭内部和家庭之间的新释放: Hy4预览和MiMo-V2.6-Flash,而双子座3.1 Pro预览则超越双子座3.8 Flash.

blocks.en: 6.3  Resource Allocation Across Seasons
blocks.zh: 6.3 跨季节资源分配

blocks.en: Trading observations and terminal cash balances reveal contrasting investment styles, as shown in Table 2 : Claude 5 GMs actively trade for championship contention, whereas GPT-6 GMs favor cautious acquisitions. Opus acquires stars and wins three championships, while Astra and Sol preserve larger cash buffers for future roster adjustments. Grok 4.7 achieves stronger competitive returns with less remaining cash, whereas Kimi K3 combines sustained improvement with greater financial flexibility. These comparisons highlight competitive returns and future investment capacity as joint criteria for assessing star acquisitions.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,交易观察和终端现金结存显示不同的投资方式: 克劳德 5个GMs积极交易争夺冠军,而GPT-6GMs则倾向于谨慎收购. 奥普斯收购明星并赢得三次冠军,而阿斯特拉和索尔则保留了更大的现金缓冲,用于未来的名册调整. Grok 4.7以较少的剩余现金实现更强的竞争性回报,而Kimi K3则将持续改善与更大的财政灵活性结合起来。 这些比较突出了竞争收益和未来投资能力是评估星级收购的共同标准。

blocks.en: Peak success and sustained improvement can diverge, as shown in Table 2 . Sonnet wins a championship and peaks at 75 regular-season wins in 2024 before falling to 65 and 56. Sol improves steadily from 45 to 71, achieving a larger G i G_{i} . Fable records 67 and 66 wins in the final two seasons and achieving G i = 28.05 G_{i}=28.05 percentage points without a championship. Renewal observations show that Sonnet faces unaffordable salary demands and loses valuable players, highlighting the need to coordinate acquisition and retention.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,峰值成功和持续改善可能有所不同。 索内特在2024年的75个常规赛季中夺得冠军,并登顶顶峰,之后跌至65和56. Sol从45到71稳步改善,实现更大的Gi i G_{i}. 寓言纪录67和66在最后两个赛季中夺冠,并实现Gi = 28.05 G_{i}=28.05个百分点,没有获得冠军. 更新观察显示,索内面临无力支付的薪金需求,失去有价值的玩家,凸显出需要协调收购和保留.

blocks.en: Cash balances complement competitive results as a measure of investment capacity. Astra and Sol retain 1006.62 and 1152.33, respectively, compared with 312.48 for Opus. MiMo-V2.6-Pro retains 925.41 in cash but ranks 23rd, with regular-season wins falling from 40 to 22, showing high balances may coexist with weak competitive returns. Cash deficits occur at different competitive levels: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (rank 7, − 21.63 -21.63 ), GPT-6 Luna (rank 13, − 41.43 -41.43 ), and MiMo-V2.6-Flash (rank 29, − 40.19 -40.19 ). These management cases illustrate linked financial pressures: salary commitments tie up future revenue, while weak results reduce revenue and constrain reinvestment.
blocks.zh: 现金余额作为衡量投资能力的尺度,补充了竞争性结果。 阿斯特拉和索尔分别保留了1006.62和1152.33,而奥普斯则保留了312.48. MiMo-V2.6-Pro保留了925.41现金,但排名第23位,常规赛季的胜负从40降至22,显示高平衡可能与弱的竞争回报并存. 现金赤字发生在不同的竞争级别:双子座3.1 Pro Prevention(排名7, - 21.63-21.63),GPT-6 Luna(排名13, - 41.43-41.43)和MiMo-V2.6-Flash(排名29, - 40.19-40.19)。 这些管理案例说明了相互关联的财政压力:薪金承诺与未来收入挂钩,而成果薄弱则减少收入和限制再投资。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Elo rankings and terminal cash in (a) American football, (b) ice hockey, and (c) baseball. The highest value in each column and sport is bold and highlighted; the second-highest is underlined. Negative cash is highlighted in red. The native GM strategy is boxed.
blocks.zh: 表3:(a)美国足球,(b)冰球,(c)棒球中的埃洛排名和终端现金. 每个栏目和运动的最高价值是大胆的和突出的;第二高的是强调的。 负现金以红色突出. 原产地的GM战略被打包.

blocks.en: 6.4  Results Across Additional Sports
blocks.zh: 6.4 补充体育运动的成果

blocks.en: Claude Opus 5.5 leads American football, matching its first-place NBA result, while Kimi K3 ranks fourth compared with ninth in the NBA, as shown in Table 2 . The six highest-ranked NBA models remain in the top seven in all three additional sports, showing consistent competitive strength across settings. The native GM strategy ranks 19th, below its NBA placement of 14th. Grok 4.7 combines seventh place with the highest terminal cash, showing that competitive leadership and cash retention remain distinct across settings.
blocks.zh: 克劳德·奥普斯5.5领先美国足球,与NBA第一名的成绩相匹配,而基米K3则在NBA第9名中排名第四,如表2所示. 排名最高的6名NBA选手在所有3个附加赛项目中都保持前7名,表现出各场竞技实力一致. 本土GM战略排名第19位,低于其NBA布局第14位. Grok 4.7将第7名与最高的终端现金结合起来,表明各环境的竞争性领导力和保留现金仍然各不相同。

blocks.en: Opus again leads ice hockey, followed by GPT-6.1 Sol, preserving their strong NBA standings. Financial outcomes transfer less uniformly: Astra, one of the two NBA cash leaders, ranks fifth but retains only 0.18, whereas Haiku holds the largest balance despite ranking 27th. The native GM strategy ranks 11th, above its NBA and American football placements, but finishes with negative cash. Across evaluated teams, terminal deficits occur in 8 of 32 hockey teams and 7 of 30 baseball teams, compared with 1 of 32 in American football and 3 of 30 in the NBA. These results show that stronger competitive performance can coexist with financial strain.
blocks.zh: 奥普斯再次引领冰球,紧随其后的是GPT-6.1 Sol,保持了他们强大的NBA地位. 财务结果转移不太统一: 阿斯特拉是NBA的两位现金领袖之一,排名第五,但只保留0.18,而海库尽管排名第27位,却保持了最大的平衡. 本土GM战略排名第11位,高于其NBA和美国足球布局,但以负现金完成. 在所有被评价的球队中,32支曲棍球队中有8支和30支棒球队中有7支出现终端赤字,而美国足球队32支中的1支和NBA的30支中的3支. 这些结果表明,较强的竞争业绩可以与财政压力共存。

blocks.en: GPT-6 Astra leads baseball, compared with second in the NBA and fifth in both American football and ice hockey. Qwen3.8-Max and Kimi K3 reverse their relative positions: Qwen ranks 14th in American football and fourth in baseball, while Kimi ranks fourth and 14th, respectively. Opus, which leads the other three sports, ranks second but ends with negative cash. Its aggressive investment leads to bankruptcy late in the evaluation, followed by player departures and a series of losses. Sonnet combines fifth place with the highest cash balance, further illustrating how financial rankings shift across sports. The native GM strategy ranks eighth. Together, these experiments assess how LLMs adapt resource allocation across sports to sustain competitive performance and future investment capacity.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Astra领先棒球,相比NBA排名第二,美国足球和冰球都排名第五. Qune3.8-Max和Kimi K3反转相对位置: 昆茵在美国足球中排名第14位,在棒球中排名第4位,而基米则分别排名第四和第十四位. Opus带领另外三个运动会排名第二,但以负现金结束. 其侵略性投资导致评价晚期破产,随后玩家离职和一系列损失. Sonnet将第5名与最高的现金余额相结合,进一步说明了金融排名如何跨越体育界转移. 本土GM战略排名第八. 这些实验共同评估了有限责任公司如何调整整个体育的资源分配,以维持竞争性业绩和未来的投资能力。

blocks.en: 7  Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Interactive benchmarks evaluate sequential actions and coordination in executable environments [ 9 , 20 ] . WebArena, AppWorld, and TheAgentCompany cover web, application, and workplace workflows [ 19 , 14 , 16 ] , while BrowserGym unifies web-agent evaluation [ 4 ] . τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench tests agent–user collaboration in a shared environment [ 2 ] , and BALROG evaluates planning and exploration across games [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 互动基准评价可执行环境中的顺序行动和协调 [9, 20]. WebArena, AppWorld, and The AgentCompany cover web, application, 以及工作场所的工作流程 [19, 14, 16],同时浏览器Gym统一网络代理评价 [4]. \\ tau^{2} - 测试代理 - 用户在共享环境中的合作 [2], BALROG 评估跨游戏的规划和探索 [11].

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks examine the long-term effects of management decisions. Vending-Bench, EcoGym, and EnterpriseArena evaluate sustained business operation and resource allocation [ 1 , 8 , 7 ] . Market-Bench, Vending-Bench Arena, and CoffeeBench study procurement, pricing, and trading in multi-agent markets [ 18 , 12 ] . E-Commerce Bench grounds year-long operations in real product and supplier data, linking repeated supplier negotiations, cash-flow management, and long-term returns [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的基准审查管理决定的长期影响。 Vending-Bench、EcoGym和EntertainmentArena评价持续经营和资源分配[1、8、7]。 市场-奔驰,旺登-奔驰竞技场,咖啡-奔驰研究多代理市场的采购,定价,交易[18,12]. 电子商务 在实际产品和供应商数据方面进行长达一年的业务,将反复进行的供应商谈判、现金流动管理和长期收益联系起来[6]。

blocks.en: Sports management links player development, contract constraints, and performance across seasons. FM-Bench combines long-term management, model competition, and equal-budget drafting in a synthetic football world [ 15 ] . FromPitch2Board uses paired seeds and controlled configurations to examine models, agent scaffolds, management roles, and evaluation horizons [ 17 ] . GM Bench evaluates cross-season resource allocation under competition across four sports, using real player data, roster types of comparable strength, and a shared LLM for player demands and negotiation.
blocks.zh: 体育管理将玩家的发展,合同限制,以及跨赛季的表现联系起来. FM-Bench结合了长期管理,模式竞争,以及合成足球界的同等预算起草[15]. FromPitch2Board使用配对种子和控制配置来检查模型,代理脚手架,管理角色,以及评价视野[17]. 全球机制 座椅在竞争下对跨季资源配置进行评估,涉及四个体育项目,使用真实的玩家数据,可比实力的名册类型,以及玩家需求与谈判的共享LLM.

blocks.en: 8  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced GM Bench , an interactive benchmark for long-horizon sports management. A shared task across four sports connects competition among LLM general managers, player interactions, and persistent resource constraints to outcomes across seasons. Experiments reveal distinct balances between championship pursuit, financial flexibility, and roster continuity. Renewal trajectories link competitive success to subsequent retention demands, highlighting anticipation of future commitments as a key element of sustained improvement. By jointly tracking competitive performance, cash reserves, and seasonal trajectories, GM Bench makes cumulative decision effects observable and evaluates the ability to sustain progress under competition.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了GM座椅,这是长期体育管理的互动基准。 四个体育项目的一项共同任务将LLM总经理之间的竞争、玩家互动以及各个赛季对结果的持续资源限制联系起来。 实验显示,在争取冠军、财务灵活性和名册连续性之间有明显的平衡。 更新的轨迹将竞争成功与随后的留用要求联系起来,突出了对未来承诺的预期是持续改进的一个关键因素。 通过共同跟踪竞争业绩、现金储备和季节性轨迹,全球机制法官组可观察到累积的决定效果,并评价在竞争下维持进展的能力。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Each sport is instantiated through a specified simulator and league configuration. The unified task structure supports evaluation across four sports, while contract systems, roster constraints, financial rules, and competition formats remain specific to each implementation. Extending the benchmark to other leagues requires corresponding rule and interface adaptations.
blocks.zh: 每个运动通过指定的模拟器和联赛配置进行即时化. 统一的任务结构支持对四个体育项目进行评价,而合同制度、名册限制、财务规则和竞争形式仍然是每个项目的具体实施方式。 将基准扩展到其他联赛需要相应的规则和接口调整.

blocks.en: Decisions are assessed over a finite number of seasons, capturing cumulative competitive and financial effects within the evaluation window. Full player careers and distant future assets may extend beyond this horizon. Longer evaluations would help characterize delayed player development, aging, and the outcomes of commitments that mature after the evaluation ends.
blocks.zh: 在有限的季节评估决定,在评价窗口内收集累积的竞争和财务影响。 完整的玩家职业和遥远的未来资产可能超越这个视野. 较长的评价将有助于描述延迟玩家发展、老化以及在评价结束后到期的承诺结果的特点。

blocks.en: Multi-season evaluation with interacting LLM roles requires repeated inference and simulation. Expanding coverage to additional models, random seeds, and league configurations increases computational cost and evaluation time. More efficient execution and parallelization of independent runs could facilitate broader experimental coverage.
blocks.zh: 具有相互作用的LLM角色的多季评价需要反复推论和模拟. 将覆盖范围扩大到额外的模型,随机种子,和联赛配置,增加了计算成本和评价时间. 更有效地执行和独立运行的平行化可以促进更广泛的实验覆盖。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: GM Bench uses real-player data to initialize simulated states. Player demands, negotiations, and market rumors are generated as fictional scenario content and do not represent the actual views, intentions, or conduct of the individuals portrayed. We interpret these interactions within their simulated roles and restrict evaluation conclusions to model behavior. All management actions are executed within the simulator, and benchmark outputs are not intended to guide real-world recruitment, contract negotiations, or financial decisions.
blocks.zh: GM座椅使用真玩家数据初始化模拟状态. 玩家的要求,谈判,以及市场谣言都是作为虚构情景内容产生的,并不代表所描绘的个人的实际观点,意图或行为. 我们在模拟角色中解释这些相互作用,并将评价结论限制在行为模型中. 所有管理行动都是在模拟器内执行的,基准产出无意指导现实世界的征聘、合同谈判或财务决定。

blocks.en: We comply with applicable source licenses and attribution requirements when reusing data and software. We document the provenance and intended use of datasets, prompts, and trajectories, and exclude private personal information and confidential content from shared materials. Our paper distinguishes source player attributes from generated interactions, avoiding the presentation of synthetic statements as factual reports about real individuals.
blocks.zh: 我们在使用数据和软件时遵守适用的源许可证和归属要求。 我们记录数据集、提示和轨迹的来源和用途,并将私人资料和机密内容排除在共享材料之外。 我们的论文将源玩家属性与生成的相互作用区分开来,避免将合成声明作为真实个体的事实报告呈现.

blocks.zh: 附录A 基准比较

We also report the number of interacting agent roles in each environment.

blocks.en: Appendix B Model List
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: The model list comprises 31 distinct models, with 29 shared across all four sports. Basketball and baseball each use these 29 models plus one scripted baseline, yielding 30 participants to match the number of teams in the National Basketball Association (NBA) and Major League Baseball (MLB), respectively. American football and ice hockey additionally include GPT-5.4 Mini and GPT-5.4 Nano, yielding 31 models plus the scripted baseline, or 32 participants, to match the number of teams in the National Football League (NFL) and National Hockey League (NHL), respectively. The details are shown in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 该模式清单由31个不同的模式组成,共有29个模式适用于所有四个体育项目。 篮球和棒球各使用这29个型号外加一个脚本基准,使30名参与者分别匹配全国篮球协会(NBA)和大联盟棒球(MLB)的球队数量. 美国足球和冰球还包括GPT-5.4 Mini和GPT-5.4 Nano,产生31个型号加上脚本基线,或32人参赛,分别与全国足球联赛(NFL)和国家冰球联赛(NHL)的球队数量相匹配. 详情见表5。

blocks.en: Appendix C Reproducibility Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 可复制性 细节

blocks.en: C.1  Evaluation Scope and Language
blocks.zh: C.1 评价范围和语言

blocks.en: The benchmark covers basketball, American football, ice hockey, and baseball. Section 5.1 describes five roster types for each sport: Balanced, Star, Twins, Offense, and Defense. All model interactions use English text. Table 1 reports 30 NBA entries, comprising 29 LLM deployments and one scripted baseline. Table 3 reports 32 entries for American football, 32 for ice hockey, and 30 for baseball, each including the scripted baseline. These counts describe the reported model-policy entries. Random-seed repetitions are reported separately below.
blocks.zh: 基准范围包括篮球,美国足球,冰球,和棒球. 第5.1节介绍了每项运动的五种名册类型:平衡型、星型、双胞胎型、防御型和防御型。 所有模型交互都使用英文文本. 表1报告了30个NBA条目,包括29个LLM部署和一个脚本基线. 表3报告美国足球32个条目,冰球32个条目,棒球30个条目,每个条目包括脚本基线. 这些统计描述了所报告的示范政策条目。 以下分别报告随机种子重复情况。

blocks.en: C.2  Inference and Experimental Selection
blocks.zh: C.2 推论和实验选择

blocks.en: All evaluated models are accessed through their official APIs. Configurable reasoning effort is set to high for every model that supports this setting. The total API expenditure for the experiments is approximately USD 15,000, as reported in Section 6.1. The local Python interpreter is version 3.9.6.
blocks.zh: 所有评估模型都通过官方API访问. 每个支持此设置的模型的配置推理工作被设定为很高. 如第6.1节所述,试验的API支出总额约为15,000美元。 当地Python解释器为3.9.6.

blocks.en: C.3  Runs and Result Aggregation
blocks.zh: C.3 运行和结果汇总

blocks.en: Each reported full-horizon model evaluation consists of one complete five-season run covering 2022–2026. Token expenditure constrained the number of full-horizon repetitions. Multiple short-horizon tests with different random seeds were used for cross-checking. The reported full-horizon results remain single-run measurements; short-horizon tests are not counted as independent five-season replications.
blocks.zh: 每一个报告的全视距模型评价包含一个完整的五个赛季运行,覆盖2022–2026年. 支出控制了全面重复的次数。 用不同的随机种子进行多次短视试验,进行交叉检查。 所报告的全视距结果仍然是单运行的测量结果;短视试验不计为独立的五季复制.

blocks.en: Section 5.2 defines the aggregation used in the result tables. Elo is the arithmetic mean of season-end ratings over the five seasons, with ratings initialized to 1500 at the start of each season and updated using K = 20 K=20 and a 400-point logistic scale. Terminal cash is measured at the end of the evaluation horizon. Table 2 reports regular-season wins by year and the difference in mean win rate between 2022-2023 and 2025-2026 ( w = 2 w=2 ), expressed in percentage points. The five seasons form a temporally dependent trajectory. The tables do not report confidence intervals across independent full-horizon runs.
blocks.zh: 第5.2节界定了结果表格中使用的汇总。 埃洛是季末收视率在五个赛季的算术平均值,每个赛季开始时的收视率初始化为1500,并使用K=20K=20进行更新,物流尺度为400分. 终端现金在评价范围结束时计量。 表2按年度报告常规赛季胜负,2022-2023年至2025-2026年平均胜负率的差额(w=2w=2),以百分点表示. 这五个赛季形成了一个时间上依存的轨迹. 表格没有报告跨独立全视距的置信间隔。
